content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Evansville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus years of direct project experience, or equivalent alternative pathways. Granite PM Academy can guide you through eligibility verification before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. You'll attend interactive sessions covering project scope, scheduling, risk, quality, and all PMBOK® Guide domains. Our nationwide online format lets you learn from your Evansville location without travel, with flexible scheduling to fit your work at local employers.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy's team can clarify documentation requirements and walk you through the online submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center or take it online. The PMP® exam is computer-based, covering all project-management knowledge areas in rigorous, real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential Over Three Years
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, you'll enter PMI's three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, volunteering, or contributing to the profession. Renew your credential on schedule to stay current and maintain recognition across your career in Evansville's healthcare, manufacturing, finance, and logistics sectors.
